title: Kayode Lab holds weekly research training and scientific discussions
body: Throughout the Fall 2026 semester, Kayode Lab has been holding weekly lab meetings focused on research training and scientific development. These sessions introduce student researchers to essential molecular biology techniques, including DNA and RNA extraction, PCR, gel electrophoresis, sequencing technologies, and bioinformatics. Through student-led presentations, scientific literature discussions, and collaborative learning, lab members are developing a strong foundation in experimental methods, critical thinking, and scientific communication as they prepare for hands-on research activities.

title: Kayode Lab welcomes new student researchers
body: We are pleased to welcome Samira, Javier, and Bailey to Kayode Lab at James Madison University. Their arrival marks an exciting step as we build our research team. We look forward to supporting their growth in molecular biology, diagnostics, and genomics through training, mentorship, and research.

title: Kayode Lab begins at James Madison University
body: Dr. Tolulope A. Kayode has launched the Kayode Lab in JMU’s Department of Biology. The lab brings together epidemiology, diagnostics, and genomics to study vector-borne disease transmission.
